title: Inner Sanctum Mysteries
paragraphs: A horror and mystery anthology famous for its creaking-door opening, mixing murder, supernatural menace, psychological terror, and darkly playful host narration.
Himan Brown horror-mystery anthology framed by the creaking Inner Sanctum door and a macabre host.

The run breaks into several distinct periods: Blue Network era (January 7, 1941 to August 29, 1943) on [[org|org.acb290b0843b31ec|Blue Network]], CBS long era (September 4, 1943 to April 17, 1950) on [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]], ABC era (September 4, 1950 to June 18, 1951) on [[org|org.0d7b5c86680811cc|ABC Radio Network]], and Final CBS era (June 22, 1952 to October 5, 1952) on [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]].
